claim: MSBase is an international online registry and platform for neurologists studying MS and other neuro-immunological diseases, focused on collaborative real-world outcomes research.
future_grounding_route: Any MSBase-derived analysis would require an approved access path and a separate pre-registered project-specific validation or replication plan.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging; identifies a large clinical outcomes registry outside this repository's public rerunnable data core.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Large international clinician-entered longitudinal real-world clinical outcomes registry.
why_unverifiable: The registry data and analyses are not public rerunnable data inside this repository and require external access/governance.
